275:     final last  = isStart ? (controller.endDate.value ?? now) : now;
276:     final initialRaw = isStart
277:         ? (controller.startDate.value ?? DateTime(now.year, 1, 1))
278:         : (controller.endDate.value   ?? now);
279:     
280:     DateTime safeInitial = initialRaw;
281:     if (safeInitial.isBefore(first)) safeInitial = first;
282:     if (safeInitial.isAfter(last)) safeInitial = last;
283: 
284:     final picked = await showDatePicker(
285:       context: context,
286:       initialDate: safeInitial,
287:       firstDate: first,
288:       lastDate: last,
289:       builder: (ctx, child) => Theme(
290:         data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
291:           colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
292:             primary: themeColor,
293:             onPrimary: Colors.white,
294:             surface: Colors.white,
295:             onSurface: Colors.black87,
296:           ),
297:         ),
298:         child: child!,
299:       ),
300:     );
301: 
302:     if (picked != null) {
303:       if (isStart) {
304:         controller.startDate.value = picked;
305:         // Jika startDate melewati endDate, reset endDate ke hari ini
306:         if (controller.endDate.value != null && picked.isAfter(controller.endDate.value!)) {
307:           controller.endDate.value = now;
308:         }
309:       } else {
310:         controller.endDate.value = picked;
311:       }
312:     }
